qualification.details: Senior Scale Stenographer: Bachelor's Degree or its equivalent from a University recognized by the Government of Himachal Pradesh. English Shorthand speed: 100 words per minute (W.P.M.) English Typing Speed: 40 words per minute (W.P.M.) Computer Knowledge: Adequate knowledge of word processing on computer. Experience: Five (05) years of regular service or regular combined with continuous ad hoc service in the feeder category (Junior Scale Stenographers/Steno-Typist/Judgment Writers working in the Hon'ble High Court of Himachal Pradesh, District Judiciary in the State, and Government/Semi-Government establishments).

selection_process: Please refer to the official notification for selection process details.
how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for HPSCDRC Senior Scale Stenographer Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Download the application form from the official website: http://hpconsumercommission.nic.in.
Fill the application form carefully with correct information.
Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates.
Check all details carefully before submission.
Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed.
Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 26-09-2026.
Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the HPSCDRC Senior Scale Stenographer recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications for the HPSCDRC Senior Scale Stenographer post is 26 September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the concerned authority before this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Senior Scale Stenographer post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Bachelor's Degree or its equivalent from a recognized university. Additionally, specific shorthand and typing speeds, along with computer knowledge, are mandatory.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Senior Scale Stenographer position?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the post of Senior Scale Stenographer in the H.P. State Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application fee for all categories is Rs. 500/-. This fee needs to be submitted along with the application form.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Senior Scale Stenographer post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary in the Pay Matrix of Rs. 38,500-1,22,700 (Level-11, Cell-1).

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for the HPSCDRC Senior Scale Stenographer recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the form and send it via post.

faq.question: Q7. What is the required shorthand speed for the Senior Scale Stenographer post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have an English Shorthand speed of 100 words per minute (W.P.M.) to be eligible for the Senior Scale Stenographer position.

faq.question: Q8. What is the required typing speed for the Senior Scale Stenographer post?
faq.answer: An English Typing Speed of 40 words per minute (W.P.M.) is required for candidates applying for the Senior Scale Stenographer role.

faq.question: Q9. Does the recruitment mention any age relaxation?
faq.answer: Please refer to the official notification for details regarding age relaxation for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I download the application form?
faq.answer: The application form can be downloaded from the official website of the H.P. State Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission, which is http://hpconsumercommission.nic.in.
